sentences.en: The attackers ordered the vendor to give them the money.
sentences.zh: 袭击者命令摊贩把钱给他们。

sentences.en: Vendors wrapped items in banana leaves and water hyacinth strings.
sentences.zh: 小贩们用香蕉叶和水葫芦绳包裹商品。

sentences.en: The vendors are just begging to take advantage of us.
sentences.zh: 这些卖主简直是在乞求趁机占我们的便宜。
